name: asva-innovation-lab
description: Corporate website and CMS for Asva Innovation Lab Pvt. Ltd.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @asva/api && npm run build -w @asva/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @asva/shared" "npm run dev -w @asva/api" "npm run dev -w @asva/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @asva/api && npm run typecheck -w @asva/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @asva/api && npm run lint -w @asva/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @asva/shared && npm run test -w @asva/api && npm run test -w @asva/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @asva/shared && npm run test:unit -w @asva/api && npm run test -w @asva/web
